accepted_claims: Exact valuation, residue and digit criteria
No summable shell-only all-n majorant, including after finite prime deletion
Sublogarithmic common carry-depth relaxation is unbounded
Fixed positive logarithmic common depth differs by at most a finite-prime constant
All-n limit of each fixed shell is 2^(-r) log(1+1/r), using Sander input
liminf f(n)=c0, using EGRS first moment
limsup f(n)>=c0+8/15, using EGRS two-base theorem
Boundedness reduces to any fixed small-prime power cutoff
limits: All analytic constants and thresholds may depend on fixed shell depth
No arbitrary-size simultaneous prime nondivisibility result
No infinite-sum interchange or exact-target upper bound
No execution of candidate or external third-party programs
minor_editorial_note: The empty prime set in Theorem 2 is a vacuous case; its nonempty construction is the substantive argument.

edition_note.editorial_clarification: Theorem 2 now explicitly disposes of the vacuous empty-prime-set case; theorem and nonempty construction unchanged.
